standard_prerequisites.name: CYT characterization (Theorem 4.2)
standard_prerequisites.statement: Delivered in context (source lines 420-424): g is CYT iff sum (d alpha - d(alpha circle Lambda)/lambda_alpha) = 0.
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: part (i) translates the CYT condition into the system (CYTsystem) via the simple-root expansion of alpha.

standard_prerequisites.name: SKT criterion (Corollary 3.4)
standard_prerequisites.statement: Delivered in context (source lines 214-220): the SKT criterion in root coordinates.
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: part (ii) translates the SKT condition into the linear system (SKTsystem).

standard_prerequisites.name: Simple-root data
standard_prerequisites.statement: Standard facts used by the author in-span: d alpha_j = sum B(H_alpha_j, H_alpha) e wedge Ie (source lines 466-469), B(H, H_alpha) = alpha(H) (source lines 513-519), and the r x p simple-root coefficient matrix (x_alpha^i) has rank r (source lines 534-538).
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: the expansion of part (ii) and the invertibility argument of part (iii).

core_obligations: Part (i): from Theorem 4.2 expand alpha in simple roots and use the linear independence of d alpha_i to obtain the non-linear system (CYTsystem).
Part (ii): from Corollary 3.4 write the SKT difference form as sum N_i d alpha_i, expand d alpha_j on each simple factor (source lines 466-473) and rescale to the linear system (SKTsystem).

Part (iii): impose both systems simultaneously as (newsystem), multiply the CYT rows by the product of the lambda_tilde_j, substitute lambda_tilde_j - 1 = sum N_k B(H_alpha_k, H_alpha_j), and prove the resulting r x r matrix is invertible via the positive-definite weighted Gram argument on the rank-r simple-root coefficient vectors; conclude N_i = 0 and lambda_tilde_j = 1, i.e. Bismut flat.
proof_roadmap: Three-part derivation: two system translations from the sibling characterizations, then a coupled-system invertibility argument (weighted Gram matrix of the simple-root coefficient vectors) forcing the Bismut-flat solution.
difficulty_reason: H2整链：152-235、355-540以Tits fibration和Aeppli/Dolbeault关系把SKT约束转root-coefficient系统，计算Bismut Ricci给CYT系统；同时满足两者时把非线性系统重组为positive root-coefficient weighted Gram matrix与Killing pairing的乘积，利用root rank和正lambda证明无非零N解，迫使metric为Bismut-flat。关键是SKT/CYT几何约束与Gram positivity结合的rigidity，单独root/codifferential公式不另计。
